fields.statement: QA at 0bee2696 with a scratch build (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch git repo with rhiza init, a real change set and untrailered code commits. rhiza check with no .rhiza/check.json and with check.json {} printed ok, no unclaimed line, exit 0. unclaimed_since 0123456789012345678901234567890123456789 exited 1 with 'rhiza: .rhiza/check.json: unclaimed_since "0123..." is not a commit in this git repository'; '-h' and malformed JSON also exited 1 naming .rhiza/check.json. repo.json was not touched.

QA at 0bee2696 with a scratch build on a scratch repo: cutoff at an untrailered commit, then commits 'no trailer', 'unknown change' (Change: 01M5ZZZ...), 'known before coauthor' (Change/Actor paragraph then Co-Authored-By), a GitHub-squash shape (bullets, two Change/Actor paragraphs, '---------', Co-authored-by), 'prose only' (see Change: <id> in prose), a .rhiza/-only commit, 'actor only' (Actor:/Leaf:), a lowercase change: trailer and a --no-ff merge of a claimed side commit. rhiza check printed ok, exit 0, and exactly 4 'warn unclaimed' lines, each with a 12-char hash and subject: no trailer, prose only, actor only (missing) and unknown change (names unknown change set 01M5ZZZ...). None for the squash, the known commit, .rhiza/-only, the merge, side or the pre-cutoff commit; check --json listed the same 4 with rule unclaimed, severity warn.

QA at 0bee2696: .rhiza/check.json holds unclaimed_since 18e33781c268cf557f5309e13d2402706ac67881, a commit (git cat-file), an ancestor of HEAD and of origin/main, equal to merge-base HEAD origin/main. With RHIZA_* unset, make self-check exits 0 (ok) and scratch-build rhiza check --json has no findings. In a clone of this checkout with an added untrailered code commit, rhiza check reported 'warn unclaimed: commit ... "stray code" ... has no Change: trailer (missing)', so the rule is on here; an added empty commit raised nothing.
